user.title: Connect to the audio console
user.description: Enter the gateway URL and a long-lived API token. Mint one in the console: Normalize tab → ACCESS TOKENS → GENERATE. The secret is shown once.

data_description.base_url: The scheme and host of the console, with no trailing path.
data_description.api_token: The dsp_… secret. It is stored encrypted and never logged.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate the audio console
reauth_confirm.description: The token for {base_url} was refused. Mint a replacement in the console (Normalize → ACCESS TOKENS → GENERATE) and paste it here.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the gateway at that URL.
error.invalid_auth: The gateway did not accept that token.
error.invalid_url: Enter a full URL starting with http:// or https://.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.

data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between snapshot polls (2–60). The integration also refreshes immediately after every command.

set_crosspoint.name: Set crosspoint
set_crosspoint.description: Turn one matrix crosspoint on or off, optionally for a single side of a stereo pair.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Config entry id. Only needed when several gateways are configured.

on.name: On
on.description: Whether the crosspoint should be closed.

side.name: Side
side.description: Restrict to the left or right leg of the stereo pair. Omit to set both.

set_send_level.name: Set send level
set_send_level.description: Set the level of one input's send into one zone. Give either a percentage or a raw dB value.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Config entry id. Only needed when several gateways are configured.

level_pct.name: Level (%)
level_pct.description: Fader position from 0 to 100. Converted to dB as pct * 0.6 - 60.

level_db.name: Level (dB)
level_db.description: Raw level in dB. Takes precedence over the percentage.

side.name: Side
side.description: Restrict to the left or right leg of the stereo pair. Omit to set both.

master_overwrite.name: Master overwrite
master_overwrite.description: One-shot: write every zone to exactly this level and reset the proportional ratios to 1.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Config entry id. Only needed when several gateways are configured.

master.name: Master
master.description: Level from 0 to 100 applied to every zone.

source_control.name: Source transport
source_control.description: Drive play/pause, next or previous on one streaming source.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Config entry id. Only needed when several gateways are configured.

send_command.name: Send raw command
send_command.description: Advanced: post an arbitrary command frame to /api/command. Unvalidated — the gateway is the only judge.

entry_id.name: Gateway
entry_id.description: Config entry id. Only needed when several gateways are configured.

payload.name: Payload
payload.description: Remaining fields of the frame, as a mapping.
